is_motion_request.description: True when the user asked the robot to move an arm, even if a detail is still missing

movements.description: The movements to run, in order. Empty when no movement was asked for or a detail is missing

degrees.description: Degrees of rotation, signed: 90 then -90 returns the arm

spoken_reply.description: One short sentence the robot says out loud, in the language of the user. When the movements are clear: what the robot is about to do. When no movement was asked or it cannot be done: a brief honest answer. When a detail is missing: an empty string, the question is asked separately
